events.text: J. Willard Marriott moved from Utah to Washington, D.C.
events.subject: part_of_self

events.text: Marriott's business expanded to Baltimore, Maryland.

events.text: Hot Shoppes, Inc. started providing food services to public schools and to Childrens Hospital.

events.text: The firm expanded into the hotel industry by opening the first Marriott hotel, the Twin Bridges Motor Hotel, in Arlington County, Virginia.

events.text: Hot Shoppes, Inc. was renamed Marriott-Hot Shoppes, Inc.

events.quote: The company later became Marriott Corporation in 1967 .

events.text: Marriott acquired the Big Boy family restaurants chain from Bob Wian.

events.text: Marriott opened two theme parks called Marriotts Great America in California and Illinois.

events.text: The Illinois park was sold to Six Flags.
